notes: Fixes a black EFB: the cockpit state feature could read the EFB brightness as 0 and write it back, so it is switched off for now.
TechLog no longer saves or writes back cockpit switches, knobs or display brightness. The Settings switch for it is gone.
TechLog makes no call to Fenix for 30 seconds after Fenix's gateway first answers, so Fenix has time to load.
